title: ASAP Key Resource Table resources
creator: Aligning Science Across Parkinson's
modification_description: Converted the ASAP Key Resource Table Guide, FAQ, and template into a machine-readable krt profile: a column schema, a core-to-ASAP column mapping, and validation severity overrides. Column names and the controlled resource-type vocabulary follow the ASAP specification. Any bundled template is independently generated to the ASAP column structure, not copied from the source workbook.
endorsement: No affiliation with or endorsement by ASAP is implied.
